subject: Provisioning: provisional prompt kit latch & MAP close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@mosaic-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning: provisional prompt kit latch & MAP close timeline

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. To keep momentum for the pilot, I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) and acceptance runway for the provisional prompt kit and testcases you plan to share. High level: we want Mosaic to provision the kit into our staging sandbox, Redwood to run the acceptance sweep, and both sides to sign off before the scheduled GA demo on Aug 07.

Proposed milestones (short):
- 07/29: Mosaic delivers prompt kit + sample dataset (sftp link / attachment).
- 07/30: Redwood provisions kit into staging (ephemeral sandbox).
- 07/31–08/04: Redwood runs acceptance tests (50 testcases, pass threshold 80% for core intents).
- 08/05: Results review + remediation plan (if needed).
- 08/06: Final sign-off / DocuSign.

Usage constraints you mentioned in the call: ephemeral tokens only, no model indexing, dataset purge after 30 days, and no downstream redistribution. Please confirm those constraints exactly so we can mirror them in the MAP. Also let us know if any of the testcases are embargoed or contain PII — we'll need IP/retention language and a brief SOC2 evidence checklist.

Attachments: please attach the prompt kit bundle and a short README for ingestion (format expectations, sample prompts). If possible include a simple CSV mapping of testcase IDs to acceptance criteria.

Next step: if you can send the kit and the draft MAP today, I'll assign Priyom to run the ingestion and Marissa to own legal coordination.

Thanks,
Jordan
Sr. Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs referenced: mosaic_promptkit_v1.zip (archive, ~12MB), mosaic_mpa_draft.pdf (PDF, draft map)

Subject: Re: Provisioning: provisional prompt kit latch & MAP close timeline

Jordan —

Thanks and yup, sending over the kit now (attached) and a short MAP draft. Confirming constraints:
- Ephemeral API keys for Redwood staging (30-day TTL).
- No persistent indexing or re-distribution; permitted: ephemeral evaluation and scoring only.
- PII: none included in this bundle; a small sample (anonymized) is in /samples/ for format testing.

We'll share the SFTP URL and the sandbox ingest README in the attachment. Legal will send redlines separately but I think the scope is straightforward.

Liam
Pilot Ops — Mosaic Analytics

---
Attachment stubs: mosaic_promptkit_v1.zip, mosaic_mpa_draft.pdf

On the logistics side, can you confirm sandbox hostname (staging.eval.redwood.ai) and a point of contact for token provisioning? We can issue the ephemeral keys once we get the environment details.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@mosaic-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning: provisional prompt kit latch & MAP close timeline

Thanks Liam — got the bundle and draft MAP, thanks for the quick turnaround. I pushed a short response file (redwood_mpa_response.xlsx) that mirrors your milestones and adds acceptance criteria columns. Key clarifications from our side:

- Acceptance gates: run full pass on 50 core testcases + 20 edge cases. Core pass threshold: 80% intent/slot correctness; no regression on safety checks.
- Test harness: we'll run using the v0.9 harness in staging; results will be pushed to the shared Drive report (link after test run).
- Security checklist: we'll need your SOC2 scan snapshot and confirmation of ephemeral key rotation policy (we rotate at 24h by default in staging). If you can't provide SOC2, we can accept the penetration report + a signed attestation for the pilot.
- Data purge: Redwood will auto-delete ingested artifacts 30 days after ingest unless we agree to an extension in writing.

Proposed updated milestone dates (concrete):
- 2025-07-29 16:00Z: Mosaic upload (done).
- 2025-07-30 15:00Z: Redwood ingest/validation complete.
- 2025-07-31 to 2025-08-04: Automated acceptance sweep + manual QA.
- 2025-08-05: Remediation/patch window.
- 2025-08-06 18:00Z: Final sign-off.

Priyom — I'll assign you the ingestion job. Marissa — can you please start a legal thread to track the short PII/retention clause and the signature? We'll aim for DocuSign by 08/06.

Jordan

---
